title: Updating the Saved Field
statement: For a register state $\sigma$ and a natural number $z$, replacing its saved field position $q$ by $z$ and then taking its register-value vector gives the same vector as updating coordinate $9$ of the original vector to $z$.
replaced:
For a register state with register-value vector $v$, replacing the value of register $9$
by $z$ gives the same vector as updating its $9$th coordinate to $z$.
